name: NBI-75043
summary: NBI-75043 is a potent and highly selective histamine H1 receptor antagonist or antihistamine which was under development for the treatment of insomnia but was never marketed. It is taken orally. The drug has been found to enhance both slow wave sleep and REM sleep in rodents.1 hours by intravenous injection in a clinical study.3 hours by these respective routes in the same study.
